parrafo_1.es: Vinales Car Wash atiende en su local de Little Havana, Miami, bajo un tunel techado donde cada carro se lava a mano, de principio a fin.
parrafo_1.en: Vinales Car Wash works out of their shop in Little Havana, Miami, under a covered wash bay where every car is hand washed from start to finish.

parrafo_2.es: Con 4.7 de calificacion en 20 resenas de Google, los clientes destacan la atencion al detalle en carros deportivos y de lujo (Porsche, Corvette, Ferrari) y lo bien que tratan hasta los carros con mas insectos y mugre acumulada.
parrafo_2.en: With a 4.7 rating across 20 Google reviews, customers call out the attention to detail on sports and luxury cars (Porsche, Corvette, Ferrari) and how well they handle even the dirtiest, bug-covered cars.

texto.es: Llegas a 1705 NW 7th St, Miami, y el equipo recibe tu carro bajo el tunel techado.
texto.en: You pull into 1705 NW 7th St, Miami, and the crew takes in your car under the covered bay.

texto.es: El equipo revisa el estado del carro y confirma el precio antes de empezar.
texto.en: The crew checks your car's condition and confirms the price before starting.

titulo.es: Lavado a mano, paso a paso

texto.es: Espuma, lavado exterior a mano y limpieza interior, con el mismo cuidado para un carro de uso diario o un deportivo.
texto.en: Foam, hand exterior wash and interior cleaning, with the same care for an everyday car or a sports car.

titulo.en: You leave with a shining car

texto.es: Segun las resenas, el resultado se nota en el brillo exterior y en que no queda ni un insecto pegado.
texto.en: According to reviews, the result shows in the exterior shine and in not a single bug left stuck on.

nota.es: Cada lavado se cotiza segun el tamano y estado del vehiculo: llama al (305) 506-9041 y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every wash is quoted based on your vehicle's size and condition: call (305) 506-9041 and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Lavado a mano minucioso, el que las resenas describen como capaz de quitar hasta el ultimo insecto del parabrisas.
texto.en: Careful hand wash, the one reviews describe as able to get every last bug off the windshield.

texto.es: Limpieza interior completa, con la atencion al detalle que los clientes destacan una y otra vez.
texto.en: Full interior clean, with the attention to detail customers call out again and again.

titulo.en: Wash for sports cars and imports

texto.es: Cuidado especial para Porsche, Corvette, Ferrari y otros autos de alta gama que pasan por el local.
texto.en: Extra care for Porsche, Corvette, Ferrari and other high-end vehicles that come through the shop.

texto.es: El mismo cuidado para la camioneta de todos los dias, con la paciencia necesaria si tu hijo necesita quedarse en el carro durante el lavado.
texto.en: The same care for the everyday family truck, with the patience needed if your child needs to stay in the car during the wash.

pie.es: No ves tu caso aqui? Llama y confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see your case here? Call and we will confirm if we can help.

items.quote: I can't recommend this car wash enough! I have a Porsche, and I'm very picky about who I trust with it. They do a phenomenal job here every single time. The service is fast, the staff is nice and professional, and the attention to detail is second to none. My car always looks immaculate and brand new when I leave. If you're looking for a car wash that truly cares about quality and takes great care of your car, this is the place!

I was worried about all the bugs on the front of my car and windshield and they got them all taken off no problem. They even allowed me and my son to stay in the car who is severely autistic while they cleaned it removed all the bugs off of it. Great service in great experience!!!
Eddie did a good job. My car is super clean, they are professional & friendly. Recommended to anyone 5 out of 5.
Got my Mustang nice and cleaned up… perfectly. Lenin did a great job.
